hypotheses.reasoning: auth-svc v4.30.0 was rolled out at 03:57:03 (#1996). It started with 'response serializer v2 enabled' (#2040). Its POST /tokens replies no longer include the 'status' field; they carry only id, state, updatedAt (#2189, #2270). account-svc validates replies against a schema that requires 'status', so every token issuance from the new build fails (#2162, #2284). Those failures are what edge-proxy reports as 502s on POST /login (#2146, #2211, #2528, etc. are downstream symptoms, not cited). Before the rollout, auth-svc returned ok on every request, and it logs zero errors itself, which matches a contract break at the serializer rather than a crash. The flag-sync ERROR lines (about unknown staging-2 flags, keeping cached value) are unrelated noise and do not explain the 502s.

flag-sync reports unknown flags in staging-2 and keeps cached values. This is a misconfiguration signal, but it is unrelated to the production login path and does not produce the missing-field failures, so it is a weak alternative only.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll back auth-svc from v4.30.0 (build 207dfed) to v4.29.5 immediately to stop the POST /login 502s. Then fix the response serializer so 'status' is present, or align the contract with account-svc, before redeploying. Separately, clean up the staging-2 flag references that flag-sync keeps flagging, since they are unrelated to this incident.
